 The Game Awards 2026: Full Nominations List
 By Jacob Fisher November 17, 2026 | 8:53 am Updated: November 17, 2026 | 10:01 am 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Pinterest 
 WhatsApp 
 Email 
 The Game Awards returns with its 12th annual ceremony on December 10, 2026, this time at the Peacock Theater, the future home of the Oscars. Games released in 2026 up until the November 20th cutoff date will be celebrated at this edition of the ceremony. This means Grand Theft Auto VI  has a strong chance of earning multiple nominations, especially since many members of The Game Awards jury have had access to the game since late October.
 However, Grand Theft Auto VI is not the only major video game expected to get recognition this year. A host of critically acclaimed video games have been released in 2026, including Resident Evil Requiem , 007 First Light , Control: Resonant , and Star Wars Zero Company . More recently,  The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time  remake has dominated critical and financial success for Nintendo, becoming one of the highest-rated video games of all time on Metacritic.
 Did your favorite game and artists score any nominations for The Game Awards 2026? See the full list of nominations below. Stay updated with DiscussingFilm as we cover the 12th annual Game Awards, airing live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on Thursday, December 10. It will be hosted by Geoff Keighley , as always, and is expected to bring a boatload of additional major video game news, along with some exciting award wins. You can also find the winners for the 2026 Oscars , Golden Globes , and Emmys right here on our site.
